## Resolution Summary
All three review comments were addressed in reconcile_database.go and keystone-upgrade-flow.md. Job construction was refactored by extracting a shared buildDBJob helper that both buildDBSyncJob and buildUpgradeJob now delegate to, eliminating the duplicated container spec, volume mounts, and security context.
